Sports Ministry Suspends Table Tennis Federation of India

The Sports Ministry has suspended the Table Tennis Federation of India (TTFI) due to governance issues. The suspension means the TTFI will not be able to conduct any activities or receive funds from the ministry. This action follows previous concerns raised about the federation's functioning. The ministry has not yet announced a timeline for the TTFI's potential reinstatement.
